name: Kinetic / death

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. One dense low physical impact and a crunchy body collapse, followed by a staggered scatter of hard debris, gritty impacts and heavy settling thuds. No ringing or electricity. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
